nodes.label: PQ leanXMSS attestations
nodes.notes: Underlined. | 2026-09-08: PoC node; harness leanEthereum/leanVM (CPU-only), see leanvm-facts.md
nodes.summary: Validators sign every attestation, and today's signatures are breakable by a large quantum computer. This worknode replaces them with leanXMSS, a hash-based post-quantum scheme, and aggregates many of those signatures into one proof produced by leanVM, so the consensus layer can verify a whole committee cheaply. The work is to make that proof cheaper to produce.

nodes.label: leanVM
nodes.summary: leanVM is the small virtual machine that produces those proofs, together with its compiler. Everything above it is only as cheap as leanVM is, so a cycle saved here is saved everywhere it runs. This worknode admits the compiler as well as the guest program, which is a wider surface than most and is stated as such.
